answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, which means paying the onyx bond on all of them and exposing each to the pearl slash. Because the wander audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 4 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Each impostor pays 9 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
